Stock market news | Shapoor Mistry Lobbied PM Modi Twice For Tata Sons IPO

Shapoor Mistry, head of the Shapoorji Pallonji Group, approached Prime Minister Modi twice regarding Tata Sons listing issues. He claims Tata Trusts are breaching regulations and obstructing the IPO for their own benefit, intensifying the battle over the listing.
